_meta.semantics: covers_syllabus_refs is an index of the objectives a stage is principally associated with; coverage is claimed only through _syllabus_items + covers_items, and only as far as coverage_check.py confirms.

_items_source.document: The Open University's BSc (Honours) Accounting and Finance, qualification code R52: the real Stage 1-3 module list and credit structure (B100, B124, B126 at Stage 1; B250, B251, B252, B253 at Stage 2; B350, B351, B352, B353 at Stage 3), cross-checked against the QAA Subject Benchmark Statement for Accounting (2025 edition)
_items_source.version: R52's Stage 3 module list (B350-B353, 30 credits each, 120 total) is stated directly and currently on open.ac.uk/courses/qualifications/r52 (fetched 2026-09-27). Stage 1 and Stage 2 are described there only narratively ('an introduction to business and management, the fundamentals of accounting, data analytics and decision making' for Stage 1; 'financial and management accounting, financial management and business law' for Stage 2), without module codes -- OU's marketing qualification pages do not itemise every stage's codes the way they do for the final stage. Each Stage 1/2 module code used here was independently confirmed live, not merely taken from an older prospectus PDF: B100 'An introduction to business and management' and B124 'Fundamentals of accounting' and B126 'Business data analytics and decision making' each show a live, scheduled future presentation (open.ac.uk/courses/modules/b100, /b124, /b126, all fetched 2026-09-27); B250 'Intermediate financial accounting' and B251 'Business law' were confirmed as the live, current prerequisites explicitly named on the B350 and B353 module pages (css2.open.ac.uk/outis/Descs/Courses/B350.htm and B353.htm, fetched 2026-09-27); B252 'Financial management' and B253 'Intermediate management accounting' were each fetched directly (css2.open.ac.uk/outis/Descs/Courses/B252.htm, B253.htm) with a live scheduled start date and a unit-by-unit syllabus outline. Two older codes that a first search pass surfaced -- B291 'Financial accounting' and B292 'Management accounting' -- were checked and ruled OUT: B291's own module page states it 'is expected to start for the last time in April 2018' (withdrawn), and B292 has no live module page at all (404, present only in the OU's digital archive of withdrawn modules) -- an old B190 stage-1 bookkeeping module was similarly ruled out as withdrawn (last started August 2017). This mirrors the withdrawn-code errors this library has caught before (LLB's F64, a Mathematics BSc guess) and is recorded here so a future audit does not need to re-derive it. B124 itself is worth flagging for a future recheck: its own module page states October 2026 as its last scheduled start -- current and valid for this build (built before that date), but due likely replacement/renumbering after 2026, so this course's grounding should be rechecked against a live open.ac.uk fetch within the next year or two.
_items_source.numbering: This course numbers its own syllabus items per real OU module: BQ1-BQ5 for a bridging quantitative-methods stage (built on B126's own content, since B126 is examined as part of Stage 1 rather than separately reachable as a standalone bridging module); B250-1..B250-10 for Intermediate Financial Accounting; B251-1..B251-4 for Business Law; B252-1..B252-7 for Financial Management; B253-1..B253-7 for Intermediate Management Accounting; B350-1..B350-8 for Advanced Financial Accounting; B351-1..B351-5 for Governance, Audit and Assurance; B352-1..B352-7 for Advanced Financial Management and Management Accounting; TAX-1..TAX-4 for Taxation; and CAP-1..CAP-4 for this course's own integrative capstone. The OU's own internal unit-by-unit numbering within each module sits behind the enrolled-student VLE and was not accessible, so this course keeps its own stable id scheme rather than reproducing gated numbering, exactly as the LLB, Mathematics BSc, Economics BSc and History BA courses in this library already do.
